shortDescription: JSSC Field Worker Answer Key 2026 out. Model key released around 6–7 Aug 2026 for exam held 19 Jul 2026. Objection window on jssc.jharkhand.gov.in.
content:
Jharkhand Staff Selection Commission (JSSC) has released the Field Worker Answer Key / Response Sheet 2026.

The written examination was held on 19 July 2026. Model answer key was published around 6–7 August 2026, with an objection window typically open for a few days after release.

How to check

  1. Visit jssc.jharkhand.gov.in
  2. Open Field Worker Answer Key / Response Sheet link
  3. Login with registration credentials
  4. Download PDF and compare responses
  5. Submit objections only within the official timeline

Final answer key and result will be published after objection scrutiny.
